# An amount that needs a digit the currency does not have.
#
# 18.190 is 18.19 written with a trailing zero and is fine. 18.191 is not a
# number of Canadian dollars at all — the cent is the unit, and a tenth of one
# is not money this book can hold.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Fuel
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000

2026-02-01 * "A tenth of a cent nobody can pay"
	Expenses:Fuel 18.191 CAD
	Assets:Bank -18.191 CAD
